title: A provisioned organization is enabled and its trial ends
description:
**Phase 3 of 5.**

- **Blocked by:** the checkout story, and the computer launch story in the provisioning epic
- **Runs in parallel with:** the suspension story
- **Unblocks:** the spend ceiling epic

---
The join between money and the lifecycle that already exists. **Stripe becomes a second caller of the enable path the members CLI already calls** — the same kernel function, covered by members_cli.feature, reached from a different direction.

Billing starts when the thing they bought exists, not before. Ending the trial and flipping the organization to enabled are one step, because a customer being billed for a pending organization is exactly the unfairness the trial was there to prevent.

No parallel subscription status. OrganizationStatus was already the right shape for this and a second status column would be two sources of truth about whether someone is a customer.

**Done when:** the scenarios exist and fail for the right reason.

comments.text:
Feature: Paid enablement

  Scenario: Provisioning completes, billing begins, workplace unlocks
    Given a paid organization that is pending
    When provisioning completes for that organization
    Then the organization status is enabled
    And the subscription trial has ended
    And its members reach the workspace

  Scenario: Enablement uses the same path as the members CLI
    Given a paid organization that is pending
    When provisioning completes for that organization
    Then the organization was enabled through the members enable path

  Scenario: An unprovisioned organization is not enabled by payment alone
    Given a paid organization that has not been provisioned
    Then its status is pending
    And its subscription is still on trial
